get.summary: Audited entry references for one passport

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An id from the passport index, such as india.

200.description: Version 4 object with passport, scope, sources and destinations (name, iso, review, rule). Review is checked for a government-backed baseline, historical for dated official archives, or unresolved for an inconclusive official review. Review status is separate from the reported entry category. Rule t: vf visa-free, voa visa on arrival, ev eVisa, eta electronic authorization/registration, vr visa or travel permit required (does not exclude eVisa), fm freedom of movement, na entry not permitted, unknown no supported answer. Rule d is explicit days; zero means no single documented day limit, never unlimited. Optional stay preserves calendar or variable periods. Rule label preserves precise wording; a lists alternative entry categories; n contains conditions; until is inclusive exemption expiry. Rule s and optional evidence reference source IDs. Sources include kind (government/reference), title, urls, checkedAt, optional sha256 and historical. Historical source dates are archive as-of dates, not claims of current verification. Reviewed replacements take precedence over withdrawals, legacy government rules and Passport Index. Unsupported withdrawn and expired claims cannot fall back to contradictory older answers. Merely unresolved routes retain prior answers with unresolved status. All 199 passports have 198 foreign destinations; current independent verification remains incomplete. Ordinary-passport short-tourist references do not determine every individual's admission, work or residence rights.
